column1: # Licence and notice texts for files the image build installs itself, outside
# any package: the scripts, units and configuration this repository puts into
# the rootfs, and the portal brand mark.
# Read by install-image-notices.sh, which copies each text verbatim to its
# destination. Each text under texts/ is a verbatim copy of <path> in <source> at
# <commit>, pinned by sha256; tools/verify-licence-notices.sh re-fetches and
# compares them, and tests/image-notices.test.sh checks they still equal this
# Columns (tab-separated): destination source commit path text sha256
